invariants.rationale: By direct inspection of the method implementation, the return value is always the product of order.getQuantity() and order.getUnitPrice().
If the quantity is negative, the result would not be positive, since a negative quantity times any price can't yield a positive price.
If the unit price is negative, the result would not be positive, as a negative unit price times any quantity can't yield a positive price.
If the result is zero, it must be because at least one of the operands (quantity or unit price) was zero.
The result can only be negative if both quantity and unit price are negative; otherwise, it will be non-negative.
